question: Susie and her sister gathered all 98 of their teddy bears and placed them on the shelves in their bedroom. If every shelf can carry a maximum of 7 teddy bears, how many shelves will be filled?
Susie's mother collected all family pictures and wanted to place all of them in an album. If an album can contain 20 pictures, how many albums will she need if there are 480 pictures?
Joe, Susie's brother, collected all 94 trading cards scattered in his room and placed them in boxes. If a full box can hold a maximum of 8 cards, how many boxes were fully filled?
Joe, Susie's brother, collected all 94 trading cards scattered in his room and placed them in boxes. If a full box can hold a maximum of 8 cards, how many cards are there in the unfilled box?

Matt and his friends were thinking of making Christmas decors for the clubhouse in their neighborhood. They are to repaint 350 balls in ten different colors. If they painted an equal number of balls for every color, how many balls are there for each color?
They had 119 matchboxes wrapped in colorful shiny wrappers. If they are to distribute the matchboxes equally to the 9 houses in the first block, how may matchboxes will each house receive?
They also gathered paper to create some star-shaped papier-mache. If each star requires 20 pieces of paper and they had 680 pieces of paper, how many stars were they able to make?
Matt had 4 small cans of gold paint. If the 34 stars that they made were to be distributed equally to the cans of paint, how many stars will be left unpainted?
Four girls were home all day one weekend preparing homemade treats. Anna made 33 blueberry cookies. If she shares this equally among her four friends, how many will each receive?
Britney brewed lemon tea that's enough to fill ten cups. If she serves this to her parents and three siblings and they share this equally, how many cups will each have?
Cristina baked 17 croissants. If she planned to serve this equally to her seven guests, how many will each have?
Cristina baked 17 croissants. If Cristina's croissants were served equally among her seven guests, how many will Cristina have left?
Drew prepared 61 servings of butterscotch. If she expects her 6 sweet-tooth guests to share the butterscotch among them equally, how many will be left unconsumed?

Allen, Charles, Lex and Shiela spent days reading books for their book report. The texts were printed very small so they were only able to cover very few pages a day. Allen read about the Solar System. He read 10 pages a day of a book which has 120 pages. How many days did it take Allen to finish reading the book?
Lex read a 420 page book about music and instruments. If he can read exactly 30 pages a day, how many days will it take Lex to finish reading the book?
Lex read another book with 240 pages. If he read the same number of pages for 12 days, how many pages did he read every day?

Shiela was into history of Asia. She can read 11 pages per hour of the book entitled "Asia's History Made Easy". If the encyclopedia has 143 pages, how many hours did it take Shiela to finish reading the book?
She had 35 mistletoe stickers and wanted to place them equally in 8 cards. How many mistletoe stickers will she have left?

Melody made 26 cut-outs of Christmas trees with red shiny balls. If she planned to paste 4 of this to the front cover of a certain number of cards, how many cut-outs of Christmas trees will Melody have left?
Melody printed 53 identical snowman drawings. If she was able to prepare cards with 4 identical snowman drawings each, how many cards was she able to prepare?
Paul got a box of 479 crayons for his birthday. At the end of the school year, he only had 134 left. How many crayons had been lost or given away?
179 birds were sitting in a tree. 38 more birds flew up to the tree. How many birds were there altogether in the tree?
Beth has 106 crayons. She gives 54 of them away to Jen. How many crayons does Beth have left?
Misha has 34 dollars. How many dollars does she have to earn to have 47 dollars to buy a dog?
James had 39 stickers. He got some more stickers for his birthday. Then he had 61 stickers. How many stickers did James get for his birthday?
